extracted_text: A promise which the promisor should reasonably expect to induce action or forbearance on the part of the promisee or a third person and which does induce such action or forbearance is binding if injustice can be avoided only by enforcement of the promise.
axiom_summary: Promissory estoppel substitutes for consideration when detrimental reliance was foreseeable and injustice-avoidance requires enforcement (bargain-substitute doctrine).
